items.quote: Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left
items.claim: Moses gave instructions to Aaron and to his two remaining sons Eleazar and Ithamar

items.quote: Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar
items.claim: The remaining meat offering from the LORD's fire offerings should be taken and eaten without leaven beside the altar
The meat offering is most holy

items.quote: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire
items.claim: The meat offering shall be eaten in the holy place as the priestly due of Aaron and his sons from the LORD's sacrifices
